title: wolfssl_ecdsa ops structs: partial init vs full explicit zero init
description: wolfssl_ecdsa_p256_ops and wolfssl_ecdsa_p384_ops use partial designated-initializer syntax (only set fields, rely on C zero-init for NULL callbacks). wolfssl_ecdh_p256_ops and wolfssl_rsa_2048_ops explicitly zero every NULL field. Inconsistent style in the same commit. The C zero-initialization guarantee makes both correct, but the inconsistency reduces readability and makes it harder to spot future accidental NULL callbacks. Pick one style and apply it across all algo_ops structs.
